description: BOSTON, MA — Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell today announced her endorsement of Ballot Question 7, the Legalize Starter Homes initiative, which would allow single-family homes to be built on lots as small as 5,000 square feet in areas with public water and sewer service, making it easier to build the smaller, more affordable homes Massachusetts families desperately need.

title: Attorney General Campbell Endorses Massachusetts Ballot Question 7 to Expand Affordable Housing Supply - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
